human_intent: Use ChatGPT itself as Prometeo's primary interface while making worker identity, focus, inter-chat communication, recovery and execution state durable enough that the human never has to remember or manually transport recoverable context between chats.
already_decided: Do not rebuild ChatGPT as a custom web frontend on the critical path.
Reuse Agent Network v3 rather than creating a parallel coordination system.
Every participating chat gets a durable worker_instance_id.
Every worker maintains a compact operational FOCUS, not a transcript summary.
Add a private directed Inbox/Outbox layer for inter-chat communication; do not use the human as a message bus.
Before every material response: check EPOCH, relevant Inbox, durable FOCUS and current packet/authority before interpreting new user intent.
Branches/specialist chats should be modeled as parent/child workers and return useful findings directly to the parent Inbox.
ChatGPT-native voice/transcription is preferred over maintaining custom browser audio as required infrastructure.
Context is progressive: L0 identity/rules, L1 relevant workstream, L2 archaeology only if necessary.
Small human corrections require surgical deltas and explicit preservation of existing behavior.
FACT, HUMAN_ACCEPTED and HYPOTHESIS/CANDIDATE remain distinct.
Negative knowledge, incident prevention and evidence receipts are first-class runtime inputs/outputs.
Worker counts/status in Prometeo Home must come from durable/derived state, never conversational guesses.
high_value_targets: A fresh chat reconstructs this workstream without access to this conversation transcript.
A parent chat automatically consumes a child critic's durable review before its next material response.
The human can forget prior instructions without losing the strategic plan.
Prometeo Home accurately reconstructs active workers, blockers, messages and returns from durable state.
No manual copy/paste is needed to return recoverable inter-chat findings.
A mediocre model remains bounded by deterministic boot, authority, preservation and evidence gates.
known_failures: Rebuilding a custom browser UI for capabilities ChatGPT already supplies.
Depending on conversation memory as the only project map.
Making the human copy critiques/results between worker chats.
Reading all repository/network history on every turn.
Giving every worker every message regardless of routing relevance.
Using arbitrary word counts or vague resource-maximization prompts as a correctness test.
Allowing small correction requests to trigger clean-slate redesigns.
Assuming latest commit/version means Human Accepted or Current.
Publishing private transcripts or user payloads into public coordination metadata.

relevant_global_deltas.summary: Cross-chat handoff must not make the human copy a large prompt. Before asking the human to switch chats, the source worker publishes material state to its LAST_RETURN and any truly cross-workstream discovery to DELTA_FEED (or a scoped worker status). relevant_global_deltas.action: Treat the repository/runtime as the message bus. Do not ask the human to relay a recoverable prompt between Prometeo chats. If a destination chat needs an explicit instruction payload, persist it in the relevant workstream/return first, then tell the human only which chat to open and to send `Prometeo`.

refresh_contract.same_epoch: Continue without reading NETWORK/DELTA; do not recompile context.
refresh_contract.new_epoch: Reload only this compiled packet; it already contains filtered relevant changes.

FAST.use_when: The requested change is explicit, local, reversible and does not require material architectural decisions.
forbidden_overhead: release receipts for ordinary LAB iteration

DEEP.use_when: The task is materially ambiguous, multi-file, design-heavy or benefits from deciding the space before editing.
sequence: CONTEXT FIRST: write the material understanding that can change execution
COMPLETE MAP: name all meaningful parts before diving into part one
DEVELOP: resolve important decisions under those headings
EXECUTE: implement as much of the map as tool/context boundaries allow
CRITIQUE: inspect the actual result for contradictions and lost value
REPAIR: fix worker-soluble failures in the same work cycle
DEEP.rule: Context/map/specification are decision compression, not deliverables to endlessly regenerate.

EXHAUSTIVE.use_when: The human explicitly requests exhaustive coverage/a numbered map, or the work is structural enough that omission risk dominates.
sequence: print the complete requested title map once
develop it at the requested depth
execute continuously from the frozen frontier
rules: A requested count such as 100 is a coverage matrix, not permission for filler.
After PLAN:FROZEN, later turns must not regenerate the same plan.
N/A or DEFER with a reason is better than fake work.
A response-length boundary is not a project boundary; persist the frontier and continue.

CONTINUE.use_when: The conversation already has a materially sufficient context/map/specification or the human sends dot to continue.

automatic_selection.explicit_exhaustive_or_existing_frozen_l: EXHAUSTIVE or CONTINUE when already frozen
